sloka: सङ्ख्ये तस्य न किञ्चित्तु रावणस्य पराभवः ।द्वन्द्वयुद्धमनुप्राप्तो दिष्ट्या ते रावणिर्हतः ।। ७.१.२८ ॥
transliteration: saṅkhye tasya na kiñcittu rāvaṇasya parābhavaḥ ।dvandvayuddhamanuprāpto diṣṭyā te rāvaṇirhataḥ ।। 7.1.28 ॥

translations.english: There was no defeat for Ravana in battle, but fortunately, having engaged in a duel, Ravana's son (Indrajit) has been killed by you.
